notes.text:
This update for ntfs-3g_ntfsprogs fixes the following issues:

- Denial-of-service in ntfs_inode_attach_all_extents() (bsc#1281758).
- Heap buffer overflow in ntfs_acl_owner() (bsc#1281756).
- Heap buffer overflow in ntfs_check_restart_area() (bsc#1281759).
- Heap buffer overflow in ntfs_ea_check_wsldev() (bsc#1281760).
- Heap buffer overflow in ntfs_external_attr_find() (bsc#1281761).
- Heap buffer overflow in ntfs_same_sid() (bsc#1281757).
- Heap data corruption in ntfs_mapping_pairs_decompress_i() (bsc#1281762).
- Heap out of bounds read/write in ntfs_ie_add_vcn() (bsc#1281763).
